learnedRules.title: Zero Localhost / Unresolvable Links in Outreach
learnedRules.condition: Pitch contains localhost or dead placeholder domain
learnedRules.correction: Strip dead link immediately. Fallback to self-contained pitch with direct UPI/contact details.

learnedRules.title: Zero Synthetic WhatsApp Dispatch Claims
learnedRules.condition: No Meta Cloud API or Twilio credentials in environment
learnedRules.correction: Classify as "MANUAL_ASSISTED_1TAP". Do NOT mark as background dispatched.

learnedRules.title: India Cold Email vs WhatsApp Channel Realignment
learnedRules.condition: Cold email conversion in Indian B2B is < 0.5%
learnedRules.correction: Prioritize WhatsApp 1-tap links and direct calls over automated cold emails for +91 numbers.

learnedRules.title: Dead Domain MX Rejection
learnedRules.condition: Recipient email domain has no valid MX records or contains @www.
learnedRules.correction: Reject before attempting SMTP to preserve Gmail reputation and avoid timeouts.

learnedRules.title: Supreme Directive: Real Income Generation Focus
learnedRules.condition: Founder Directive: Ab real income generate krne pr full focus kijiye
learnedRules.correction: 100% operational focus on converting verified buyers into genuine UPI settlements (9690973030@ibl) and bank deposits. Direct 1-tap WhatsApp closing, live pitch delivery, and instant UTR reconciliation take absolute priority over all other background routines.
